text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Before I knew it, it got this 
late.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I watch the members of 
"DREAMS"... I completely lose track of 
time.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I was so swept up by your passion that my 
whole body started tingling.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
However, it takes enough passion to make 
onlookers take it seriously in order to 
reach for greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
This team has what it takes to take on the 
world. So I'll give it all I've got! Let 
us do everything within our power as well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You can feel Casino Drive's deep trust in 
the team!
